description: Shell script for CPU and memory recovery monitoring of Advsec agent, including resource usage checks, process management, and logging.

methods.name: get_agent_pid_list
methods.description: Collects process IDs of agent processes.

methods.name: get_agent_cpu_time_spent
methods.description: Calculates total CPU time spent by agent processes.

methods.name: log_agent_cpu_statistics
methods.description: Logs CPU statistics of agent processes.

methods.name: log_agent_mem_statistics
methods.description: Logs memory usage of agent processes and triggers restarts if thresholds are exceeded.
